title: One Prior, Two Dynamics: Repurposing Video Diffusion Transformers for Self-Supervised Latent Action Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.26617v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Videos reveal how the world changes, but rarely the actions that cause those changes. Latent action learning recovers such supervision from visual transitions, yet often learns the underlying dynamics largely from scratch. We ask whether a pretrained video generator can instead provide the prior for both inverse and forward dynamics. We introduce O$^{2}$LaF, built on a simple principle: one prior, two dynamics. We initialize both models from the same pretrained video DiT and adapt them to their distinct roles: a feed-forward transition encoder with learnable action queries for inverse dynamics, and a causal, action-conditioned video generator for forward dynamics. By controlling information access and optimizing both dynamics end-to-end through a compact bottleneck, O$^{2}$LaF learns transferable actions from unlabeled videos. Across navigation and robotic manipulation, O$^{2}$LaF sets a new state of the art in few-shot action probing

translated_title: 一个先验，两种动力学：将视频扩散Transformer重新用于自监督潜在动作学习
translated_abstract: 视频揭示了世界如何变化，却很少揭示导致这些变化的动作。潜在动作学习从视觉过渡中恢复此类监督信号，但其底层动力学往往需要从零开始学习。我们提出一个问题：预训练的视频生成器能否同时为逆向动力学和前向动力学提供先验？我们提出了O²LaF，它建立在一个简单的原则之上：一个先验，两种动力学。我们从同一个预训练视频DiT初始化两个模型，并使其各自适应不同的角色：一个带有可学习动作查询的前馈式过渡编码器用于逆向动力学，以及一个因果的、以动作为条件的视频生成器用于前向动力学。通过控制信息访问并通过紧凑的瓶颈端到端地优化两种动力学，O²LaF从无标注视频中学到了可迁移的动作。在导航和机器人操作任务上，O²LaF在少样本动作探测中创造了新的最先进水平。
tldr: 该论文提出O²LaF，通过将同一个预训练视频扩散Transformer分别适配为逆向动力学过渡编码器和前向动力学动作条件生成器，从无标注视频中自监督学习可迁移的潜在动作，并在导航与机器人操作的少样本动作探测中达到新的最先进水平。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes O²LaF, which repurposes a single pretrained video diffusion transformer as both an inverse dynamics transition encoder and a forward dynamics action-conditioned video generator, enabling self-supervised learning of transferable latent actions from unlabeled videos and setting a new state of the art in few-shot action probing for navigation and robotic manipulation.
